record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: OnSimulationStartEffect (shared instance): one-time luck debuff on every opposing entity
record.summary: PassiveEffects[Passive.BAD_LUCK] holds one OnSimulationStartEffect. When the simulation starts, every entity of both teams has its OnSimulationStartEffects applied; for a Murkrow or Honchkrow entity the callback walks the whole board and, for each occupied cell whose entity is on the other team, requests -20 luck on that enemy (the enemy is passed as its own caster, apBoost 0, no crit, not permanent). addLuck does not round, applies the Big Eater Belt and Twist Band helpers, and clamps luck to -100..100. Because the caster is the enemy itself, a Big Eater Belt holder multiplies this negative change by 1.25 (rounded with the 'down' mode; the direction for negatives was not traced, so the exact applied number, -25 or -26, is not stated) and Twist Band does not flip it (same team). Each Murkrow / Honchkrow entity applies it once, so several of them stack down to the -100 floor. It runs once at the start; it does not follow later spawns, deaths or moves. The identifier BAD_LUCK also exists as an EffectEnum member, but no code in app/core uses it.
triggers: Simulation.start: OnSimulationStartEffect of each Murkrow / Honchkrow entity (both teams' entities are processed)

effects.declaredRaw: -20 luck requested on every opposing entity present on the board at simulation start
effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false: no AP or crit factor, no rounding for luck. The caster argument is the target itself, so applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff treats the negative value as a change from the holder's own team and scales it by 1.25 for a Big Eater Belt holder (rounded 'down'); applyTwistBandBuff does not flip it because caster.team equals the holder's team. This differs from an 'environment' caster such as the MURKY weather effect (where Twist Band would flip a debuff). core-mechanics §I and item-effects.md (TWIST_BAND, BIG_EATER_BELT) were consulted.
effects.resolution: requested -20 per source entity; applied = -20 (or the Belt-scaled value) per source, summed over sources, then clamped so luck stays within -100..100. permanent is false, so the enemy's board pokemon is unchanged. Opposing entities already at -100 are unchanged.

effects.declaredRaw: applied once when the simulation starts
effects.resolution: no repeat: entities spawned later (summons, resurrections) are not visited; a Murkrow that dies later does not undo the debuff.

conditions: only occupied cells with an entity whose team differs from the holder's
evaluated at simulation start for each holder entity
units on the holder's own team are untouched
luck matters only to effects that read it, e.g. Metronome (rarity roll), Present (chance) and Arm Thrust (hit count) among those found by name search
record.resetBehaviour: No per-entity state in the effect. The luck change lives on the fight entity only (permanent false) and is rebuilt from the board pokemon if the entity is rebuilt (resurrect() overwrites luck from the clone).

Spectral Thief's luck copy and Feather Dance's luck changes interact with the debuff only through addLuck and were not traced in detail
